title: Analysis code for "Symptom phenotypes and mortality in US cancer survivors: a cohort study"
description:
Analysis code for the manuscript Symptom phenotypes and mortality in US cancer survivors: a cohort study (National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey 2005-2018 with NCHS linked mortality follow-up through 2019).

The code downloads the public NHANES files and the NCHS public-use linked mortality files, assembles the cohort of adult cancer survivors, fits the latent class models of the nine PHQ-9 items, sleep duration and previously reported sleep trouble, estimates survey-weighted Cox models with modal class assignment and with a maximum-likelihood three-step correction for misclassification (jackknife and bootstrap replicates that repeat all three steps), runs every sensitivity analysis reported, and builds every table and figure. zsh code/run_pipeline.sh runs all stages in order; code/README.md lists the stages and requirements (R 4.6 with survey, survival, poLCA, rms and nnet; Python 3.11 or later with pandas, numpy, statsmodels, matplotlib and requests).

The archive contains code only; no NHANES data are included. In a check on 25 September 2026, the pipeline run in a fresh clone with a fresh download from the CDC reproduced every table of the manuscript byte for byte, and every figure byte for byte when drawn with matplotlib 3.11.0 (details in code/README.md).
notes: Data sources: NHANES 2005-2018 public-use data files (https://wwwn.cdc.gov/nchs/nhanes/) and the NCHS public-use linked mortality files with follow-up through 31 December 2019 (https://www.cdc.gov/nchs/linked-data/mortality-files/). The data are not redistributed in this archive; code/download_nhanes.py retrieves them from the CDC. Their use is governed by the NCHS Data User Agreement (https://www.cdc.gov/nchs/policy/data-user-agreement.html), not by the MIT License of the code.
